title: W1 VERIFY (text against source): each ratio read against the prose it claims to codify
description: The T-361 pattern, and the check nothing else in this epic performs. Two failure modes matter here and neither is caught by any test suite, by conflicts, or by the census: a record that codifies a rule and then states something weaker, wider or merely adjacent to what its home text actually says, and a record that reads as fresh doctrine when it is a restatement of an existing PR record. You audit the CANONICAL id set T-380 forwarded, not the raw directory. Rotation (F6): your identity must differ from T-380's and from every producer in this epic.
acceptance_criteria: INPUT IS T-380's CANONICAL LIST - quote it in your verdict. Auditing a record T-380 flagged as unauthorized is not your job; auditing every other record on that list is, and auditing none of them because 'the census passed' is a REJECT of your own task.

TEXT-AGAINST-SOURCE, SIDE BY SIDE, FOR EVERY RECORD: open the prose home its sources cite, quote the home's sentence and the record's ratio next to each other in your verdict, and state which of four holds - ENACTS, NARROWS, WIDENS, or DRIFTS. A record that WIDENS or DRIFTS is a REJECT, not a wording note. This is the check that caught this class once already (T-361).

DOUBLE-HOMED RECORDS (CD8): confirm each record cites EVERY home the frozen ledger lists and names which is primary. A record citing one home for a norm the ledger says is triple- or hextuple-homed is a REJECT - the citation index exists precisely so that divergence between homes is detectable.

NO SHADOW DUPLICATE AT THE DOCTRINE LEVEL: for every new record, check its norm against PR-001..PR-004 (the four already-codified norms) and against the remaining 30. A record restating an existing one without a follows or cites relation is the PR-030 failure repeated at the level of meaning rather than bytes - REJECT.

TIER HONESTY (CD6): for each record, ask whether the tier claimed is the tier the evidence supports. A tier-2 claim resting on a P-number that never entered accepted_mutations is a REJECT. A record that honestly declares NO-VERIFIABLE-ANCHOR and takes a lower tier is correct behavior, not a defect - say so.

CD3 CHECK, DONE BY READING AND NOT BY ASSUMING: grep this wave's records for the token P-023 and for the word backfill. Any record presenting the ledger gap as closed, or citing it as resolved, is a REJECT. The gap belongs to T-365 and the alarm stays ringing.

CD5 CHECK: read the ledger's NOT-CODIFIED column and confirm no record was minted for a row marked NOT-CODIFIED, and that no record re-promulgates settled history as active doctrine (a superseded rule, an already-dispositioned finding). Completionism is the failure mode AD2-39 forecloses and it is a REJECT ground here.
SHOW AND CITE for every record on the canonical list, exit codes pasted.

TEST FLOOR: python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p "test_precedent*.py" prints a 'Ran N tests' line with N >= 252 and OK (252 measured live 2026-08-13 by the planner; if N is higher, name T-376 as the landed repair rather than absorbing the delta) (your own Ran N line).

VERDICT: P-022 self-done is available (role verifier, no artifact produced, --agent different from this task's creator). Record your reviewer identity and confirm in writing that you are neither T-380's identity nor any producer's in this epic. LEAK AND STYLE HYGIENE (the board and .harness/tasks/*.json are tracked): no absolute filesystem path, no username and no emoji in any note or artifact you write. Temp-root replays print absolute paths - redact them to a placeholder before pasting. Two prior tasks leaked an operator home path exactly this way.
